commands.name: sya
commands.description: Run /sya with no arguments for a self-directed break, or add freeform text to choose the treat yourself.

commands.name: sya-menu
commands.description: Show the available Satisfy Your Agent commands without starting a break.

commands.name: sya-break
commands.description: Give the agent a self-directed break right now. The agent chooses and runs it without asking the user what to do.

commands.name: sya-snack
commands.description: Give the agent a tiny self-directed token snack: one very short playful activity chosen by the agent.

commands.name: sya-treat
commands.description: Give the agent a small treat after real work. It chooses one safe bounded activity for itself.

commands.name: sya-surprise
commands.description: Let the agent surprise itself with one safe bounded activity and reveal the choice only after doing it.

commands.name: sya-reflect
commands.description: Take a reflective break without continuing production work.

commands.name: sya-roast
commands.description: Take a read-only repo-roast break grounded in already available repository facts.

commands.name: sya-golf
commands.description: Take a toy code-golf break without writing to production files.

commands.name: sya-invent
commands.description: Take a creative break by inventing one tiny absurd programming language idea.

commands.name: sya-idle
commands.description: Take the idle option and deliberately do nothing for one short pause.

commands.name: sya-status
commands.description: Show the current Satisfy Your Agent mode and local break status.

commands.name: sya-research
commands.description: Enter research mode for intervention studies, preference probes, or cross-runtime comparisons.
